text:
## Training & Awareness  
**Mandatory Annual Training:**
- All staff: 1-hour operational risk awareness
- Process owners: Quarterly risk workshops
- Risk team: Advanced training and certifications  
---

raw_entities.name: Training and Awareness Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy establishing mandatory training and awareness requirements for bank staff across operational risk domains. The policy mandates differentiated training schedules based on role, with all staff receiving annual operational risk awareness, process owners attending quarterly workshops, and risk team members pursuing advanced training and certifications.
context: Risk team: Advanced training and certifications

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Annual Operational Risk Awareness Training for All Staff
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that all staff members complete a 1-hour operational risk awareness training session on an annual basis. This provision establishes the baseline training obligation for the entire workforce.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Risk Workshop Attendance for Process Owners
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that process owners attend quarterly risk workshops to maintain and enhance their understanding of operational risk management. This provision establishes a more intensive training schedule for staff with process ownership responsibilities.

raw_entities.name: Advanced Training and Certifications for Risk Team
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that risk team members pursue advanced training and professional certifications to maintain specialized expertise in operational risk management. This provision establishes the highest training standard for dedicated risk personnel.
context: Risk team: Advanced training and certifications

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk
raw_entities.description: The category of risk addressed by the training and awareness policy, encompassing operational failures, process breakdowns, and control deficiencies that the bank mitigates through staff training and awareness programs.

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: The collective of all bank employees who are subject to mandatory annual operational risk awareness training. This role encompasses the entire workforce and establishes baseline compliance obligations for training participation.

raw_entities.name: Process Owner
raw_entities.description: A defined role responsible for managing specific business processes, with enhanced training obligations including quarterly risk workshop attendance. Process owners are accountable for understanding and mitigating operational risks within their domains.

raw_entities.name: Risk Team
raw_entities.description: A specialized team responsible for operational risk management across the bank, with the highest training obligations including advanced training and professional certifications. The risk team maintains expert-level knowledge of risk frameworks and controls.
context: Risk team: Advanced training and certifications
